The '''trill beast''' was a small, dangerous [[Species/Legends|species]] of animal<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Breshig]],<ref name="Homeworld" /> located in the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> A [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] once left a [[sound chip]] of a pre-recorded trill beast inside their [[T-P-C4 Live Organism Comfort Conveyor]] to scare away customs officers onboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Alamintari]]''. The smuggler was hiding ten [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of rare [[Garcornian spice]] inside.
